title: Time series: three parallel series over a six-hour window
proves: a generate with start, end and interval makes one row for each window point and series: 6 points x 3 series = 18 rows
the end of the window is exclusive: the last tick is 05:00
ts.series numbers the series, ts.step the point, ts.now the tick time
the time column is a timestamp role and stays inside the window

the tick spacing is one hour: a row condition ties the minute of the day (from ts.now) to the step (minute_of_day = hour x 60); CE has no composite uniqueness expectation for (sensor, hour), so the row count and the spacing guard it
